name: Sony Financial Group Inc
summary: Sony Financial Group Inc., a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, provides an extensive array of financial solutions throughout Japan, operating through its various subsidiaries. Its diverse portfolio includes a wide range of insurance products, such as life coverage (death protection, living benefits), health and educational endowments, and protection for automobiles, overseas travel, and property against fire, along with reinsurance services. Furthermore, the company offers foreign currency deposit accounts, mortgage lending, investment trusts, venture capital funding, and credit card processing. Distinctively, it also engages in the planning, development, and operation of nursing care facilities. Founded in Tokyo in 1979, the firm was formerly known as Sony Financial Holdings Inc. before officially adopting its present name, Sony Financial Group Inc., in October 2021.
